segments.text_en: Cosmic decision and divine selection
evidence: It was time to decide destinies in heaven and on earth,
Lagash had raised the head towards heaven in large ‘me’,
Enlil looked righteously upon lord Ningirsu.
The ‘heart’ of Enlil, it is the river Tigris, did it not bring sweet water?

segments.text_en: Ningirsu commands the temple building in a dream vision
evidence: To the house its king spoke:
“I will make the ‘me’ of Eninnu emerge in heaven and on earth.
It was then, in a ‘dark goat’, that towards his king, on the lord Ningirsu, Gudea looked.
“Build his house!,” he ordered him.

segments.text_en: Gudea deliberates on the obscure dream and seeks Nanše
evidence: Gudea, his ‘heart’ is distant, counseled about the message:
Of what my ‘dark goat’ has revealed to me, its ‘heart’ I did not know.
Let me bring my dream to her, to my mother.
Nanše, my divine sister from Siraran, may she make its meaning visible for me.

segments.text_en: Journey and supplication to Ningirsu at Bagara
evidence: Did he not set foot on his barge?
After reaching Bagara—house hanging over the river, he sacrificed bread, he poured out cold water,
Hero, you spoke to me, let me do it right for you, Ningirsu, let me build your house for you,
From Gudea, his offering and his prayer, his king, the lord Ningirsu, received from him.

segments.text_en: Supplication and appeal to Gatumdu for maternal protection
evidence: He went to Shiny-Gatumdu, (and then) he is saying an offering(!) to her:
I am a no-mother-haver, you are my mother. I am a no-father-haver, you are my father.
may your good Utukku go in front of me, may your good Lamma follow me on my path.
His lady, the offering and the prayer, Shiny-Gatumdu received from Gudea.

segments.text_en: Arrival at Nina and recounting the dream vision to Nanše
evidence: He went to Nanše, he prayed to her: “Nanše, large lady, lady of precious, precious, ‘me’.
Inside the dream there was one man, his greatness was like heaven, his greatness was like the earth.
She held a stylus of purified silver in the hand. She had the tablet of the stars on her lap.
Secondly, it was a hero, he bent the arm, he held a lapis writing board in the hand, he drew the plan of the house.
the brick of deciding destinies was placed in the mold for me.

segments.text_en: Nanše interprets the dream figures and prescribes gifts
evidence: His mother, Nanše, answered the governor: “My shepherd, let me, me interpret your dream for you.
it is surely my brother Ningirsu. ‘Build his shrine, the Eninnu!’ He ordered you.
That is surely Nisaba, my sister.
it is Nindubba, placing the house on the plan of the house.
He will reveal the plan of his house to you. The hero, his ‘me’ are the greatest, he shall let it grow for you.”

segments.text_en: Gudea fashions ritual gifts and enters Eninnu
evidence: He broke the seal of his treasure house, he brought out wood.
He made it straight for him, for the lapis chariot.
With his beloved harp, ‘dragon of the land’, the famous roaring wood, with which he councels,
Joyfully he entered to him in the house.

segments.text_en: Second supplication and plea for a definitive sign
evidence: To Šugalam, the terrible place, the place of rendering justice,
He rose for his king in public, he prayed to him,
Ningirsu, I will build your house for you, (but) my sign is my not.
Hero, your remote, like the heaven, ‘heart’, son of Enlil, lord Ningirsu, I, what can I learn from you?”

segments.text_en: Ningirsu's direct epiphany and cosmic covenant
evidence: Gudea, I will surely give you the sign of the building of my house.
My house, Eninnu, founded by An, its ‘me’ is bigger than all the other enormous ‘me’
With the founding of my house, may abundance arrive.
I will build the house for you at day, at night I will let it grow for you.
On that day (when) your arm is touched with fire, I will teach you my sign.”

segments.text_en: Omen verification, social purification, and site sanctification
evidence: Gudea rose, it was a dream. He is afraid, it was a dream.
He struck the hand into the goat, his goat is good.
The governor cleansed the city, he spun it with fire.
(For the) platform, he cleanses 24 ‘iku’ of the city for him, he purifies the platform for him.
The Anunna of area-Lagash, in order to build the house of Ningirsu, with Gudea in offering and prayer, they stood with him.

segments.text_en: General levy across Lagash and assembly of foreign nations
evidence: On that day, the governor arranged a levy in his land, in the totality of all of his lands.
The sun-disk, it is the emblem of Inanna, went at its head.
Elam came to him from Elam. Susa came to him from Susa.
Magan and Meluhha, from their land, submitted to him.
For the construction of Ningirsu’s house, they assembled for Gudea in his city Girsu.

segments.text_en: Procurement of timber, stone, and precious metals from distant lands
evidence: To the land of cedar, where no man enters, for Gudea, the Lord Ningirsu made way for him.
He cut down its cedars with the great axe.
To the land of stone, where no man enters, Gudea for the Lord Ningirsu made way for him.
From Kimaš, the mountain of copper, (that) revealed itself to him, the copper he excavated there in its excess basket(?)
Purified silver is being brought down for Gudea from its mountain.

segments.text_en: Ascetic devotion, divine surveying, and site layout
evidence: Concerning the building of his king’s house, he does not allow sleep to enter during midnight,
Nisaba, the house of wisdom, she opened for him. Enki made the plan of the house right for him.
the field was right, he measured it, he placed sticks on its border, he knew himself.
For the second time Gudea went out of the shiny city, he sacrificed perfect oxen and perfect goats,

segments.text_en: Ritual fabrication of the first sacred brick
evidence: The shiny basket, the righteous mold of deciding destinies, he raised to Eninnu.
Gudea placed clay in the mold. The cultic order emerged.
(About) his brick placed in the mold, Utu was pleased with it.
He placed the brick, he brought the mold into the house, he lifted the brick from the mold, it is a shiny throne raised to heaven.
She is establishing the plan of the house, it is Nisaba whose ‘heart’ knows counting.

segments.text_en: Anxious devotion, omen confirmation, and cosmic separation vision
evidence: Like a young man building a new house, he does not allow sweet sleep to enter his eyes.
Like a cow whose eye are on its calf, he walked to the house in great concern.
he stretched his hand in the goat, his goat was good.
To build his king’s house, the separation of Eninnu from heaven and earth, was brought to his attention.

segments.text_en: Laying the foundation walls and seven ritual blessings
evidence: Enki places the foundation of the house, Nanše, the daughter of Eridu cared for the omen taking.
The mother of Lagash, Shiny-Gatumdu, bore its bricks in flows.
he placed the foundation, the wall touched the ground, he gave a blessing, he stroked the brick with flax.
For the seventh (time) did he not give a blessing in the house? It is Eninnu—Moon passing (through)—filling the land.

segments.text_en: Raising the timber roof and mountain-like cosmic superstructure
evidence: They place the wood of the door. It is the green sky lifting the crown.
They make the house grow like a mountain. They make it float in the middle of the heaven like a cloud.
The governor built the house, he made it grow, he made it grow like a large mountain,
He made Eninnu firm as a mast.
on the seventh day he seized them in the house.

segments.text_en: Erection and naming of the commemorative stelas
evidence: His stone erected in the mighty courtyard, ‘the stela, king filling the courtyard, Lord Ningirsu made Gudea known from Girnun,’ as name of that stone he named.
His stone erected in Kasurra, ‘the king, flood of Enlil, no-haver of opponent, Lord Ningirsu, on Gudea looked righteously,’ as name of that stone he named.
His stone erected in front of the rising sun, ‘the King, roaring storm of Enlil, lord no-haver of rival, Lord Ningirsu, Gudea, in his shiny ‘heart’ called him,’ as name of that stone he named.
His stone erected in Baba’s back-room, ‘Eninnu, knowing the face of An, Baba, life of Gudea,’ as name of that stone he named.

segments.text_en: Cosmic splendor and architectural perfection of the temple
evidence: He build the house of his king with righteousness. The righteous shepherd Gudea made it grow together with heaven and earth.
Gudea made Ningirsu’s house go out from the cloud like Utu, made it grow like a mountain of Lapis,
They prepare the meal in the great sanctuary, it is gold bowls filled with honey and wine, standing under the heaven.
He built, and after he had finished it, it is the ‘heart’ of the gods, returned to its banks.

segments.text_en: Installation of vanquished monster trophies and slain warriors
evidence: At the war-door of the inner room, where the weapon hang, Sagar, the hero, the six headed ram, he seizes there.
At the frightening place facing the city, the seven heroes he seizes there.
At Šugalam, the gate of radiance, the dragon and the date palm he seizes there.
Because they are dead warriors, he placed their mouths at the libation place, (and) their names, in the midst of the gods, Gudea, governor of Lagash, made them emerge.

segments.text_en: Installation of mythological door fixtures and sanctification
evidence: The cedar doors standing in the house, it is Iškur roaring from heaven.
Eninnu, its lock, a bison(?), its pivots, a lion; from its bolt, Muššatur (and) Mušhuš stretch out the tongue against an aurochs.
The fear of Eninnu, on all the lands, like a garment, it covered.
Its king, Lord Ningirsu, chose it in his shiny ‘heart’, he poured it on top like good incense.
Gudea, in the brilliance of heaven, decorated it.

segments.text_en: Establishment of cultic provisions, storehouses, and ceremonial rooms
evidence: From the cow pen, oil deliveries, milk deliveries, From the mighty oven, large cakes, large croissants(!?).
The wine-cellar(?) (called) ‘mountain dripping with wine’. From the brewery, (called) ‘Tigris is being water in its might’.
In the treasury, precious stones, silver, tin. The coach house, (called) ‘mountain standing on the ground’.
The inner room of harps, (called) ‘ox roaring princely’. The courtyard, shiny prayers, ‘sim’ and ‘ala’ (sounds).

segments.text_en: Cosmic awe over the land and concluding doxology to Ningirsu
evidence: The big fear of the house rests on the land. Its praise reaches the mountains.
The fear of Eninnu covers all the lands like a garment. The house (was) built in joy by its king.
Ningešzida built it on a big place. Gudea, governor of Lagash, placed its foundation.
For the restoration of Eninnu Ningirsu be praised! The building of the house of Ningirsu, this is the middle of the praise.
